_about: Security re-reviews of 1ce075e and 36a9f54 (2026-10-28), written by a reviewer agent that probed paysAway and liftsCash. Beside cash: scam asks the reader may refuse; fair notes it never may. A dev set now (the rules were fixed on it), not a measure. The re-review of 0d2996f added its 30 scams, 7 cash variants and 39 fair notes, plus the commit review's comma and question cases, one note per new remote sign and past-tense senders. The three family hand-offs an older rule refused by code are fair now (the lead's third-party default, 2026-10-28).
